name: ue-shed
description: External tools for Unreal Engine development.

scripts.check: pnpm run uasset:check && pnpm run engine:check:native && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run effect:architecture && pnpm run license:check && pnpm run stylex:check && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:release:packages && pnpm run test:adoption:data-authoring && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run contract:check && pnpm run test
scripts.check:precommit: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run stylex:check && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run contract:check
scripts.contract:check: pnpm --filter @ue-shed/protocol contract:check && pnpm --filter @ue-shed/cameras contract:check && pnpm --filter @ue-shed/niagara contract:check
scripts.engine:check:native: cargo clippy -p engine-process-supervisor --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p engine-process-supervisor --all-targets
scripts.test:release: node scripts/sync-native-versions.ts --check && node --test scripts/create-release-candidate.test.ts scripts/plugin-bundle.test.ts scripts/release.test.ts
scripts.release:version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-native-versions.ts && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:cli && pnpm run test:e2e:workbench
scripts.benchmark:uasset:wasm: pnpm run uasset:build:wasm && cargo build --locked --release -p uasset-io && node scripts/benchmark-uasset-wasm.ts
scripts.test:unreal-niagara: pnpm --filter @ue-shed/engine build && pnpm --filter @ue-shed/niagara build && node --import tsx scripts/test-unreal-niagara.ts
scripts.test:uasset-wasm: pnpm run uasset:build:wasm && cargo build --locked --release -p uasset-io && node scripts/test-uasset-wasm.ts
scripts.uasset:check: pnpm run uasset:architecture && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy -p uasset-parser --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p uasset-parser --all-targets && cargo clippy -p uasset-inspection --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p uasset-inspection --all-targets && cargo clippy -p uasset-io --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p uasset-io --all-targets && pnpm run uasset:check:wasm
scripts.uasset:check:wasm: cargo check --locked -p uasset-parser --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/uasset-inspection-wasm/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/uasset-inspection-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && pnpm run test:uasset-wasm && node scripts/test-uasset-wasm-browser.ts && pnpm run test:uasset-wasm:package
